run_config.training_pool: entire manifest normal_training_pool; excludes all 20 calibration images
run_config.architecture: four stride2 Conv3x3 encoder blocks 16/32/48/64; nearest-upsample Conv3x3 decoder 48/32/16/3; ReLU, final sigmoid
run_config.augmentation: independent horizontal and vertical flips p=.5 per training image; no synthetic defects
run_config.input_geometry: same short-edge448 bicubic and bottom/right crop to14 as Template; reflection pad bottom/right to16 for AE, crop reconstruction back
run_config.map: mean absolute RGB reconstruction error, Gaussian sigma2 on input grid; no morphology
run_config.image_score: mean largest floor(1% of unpadded input-map pixels), at least1
run_config.native_map: OpenCV linear resize to original size; original GT unchanged
run_config.threshold: linear 95th percentile of exactly20 held-out normal calibration scores
run_config.selection: fixed architecture/12 final epochs a priori; no test-label selection, no calibration fitting or early stopping
run_config.precision: float32; no AMP; native maps stored losslessly as float32 compressed NPZ
run_config.determinism: fixed seeds; cudnn deterministic true; benchmark false; torch threads4
run_config.comparison_scope: normal-training extension, not a K-shot experiment; training counts reported separately
